18ad9778ead13a0577ba34f40da653b5b089d029.sourceText:
注意，这里的`<pose>0 0 0.055 0 0 0</pose>`里的`0.055`不是底盘高度。
实际上是chassis 坐标原点 → 底盘质心 COM 的 Z 偏移。
北极熊这套规定`chassis z=0 等于 轮轴中心平面`。
所以如果机器人实际重量都在顶上，质心大概在高出轮轴中心平面 xxx mm的地方，那就填 `<pose>0 0 xxx 0 0 0</pose>`。
18ad9778ead13a0577ba34f40da653b5b089d029.translatedText: Note that the`<pose>0 0 0.055 0 0 0</pose>`here`0.055`does not refer to the chassis height\. It is actually the Z offset from the chassis coordinate origin → chassis center of mass COM\. This Polar Bear system specifies`chassis z=0 等于 轮轴中心平面`Therefore, if the actual robot weight is all at the top, and the center of mass is approximately xxx mm above the wheel axle center plane, then fill in`<pose>0 0 xxx 0 0 0</pose>`\.
